Hi Mike,

Sorry for the slow reply, and yes, that swap is absolutely possible.

I've checked your order Shop····. The T. X1 line hasn't shipped, so I can move it over to the Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s) on the same order number. The P2 is $379 against the $219 you paid for the X1, so the difference is $160 plus tax. Once you confirm, I make the change and the store emails you the invoice for the difference right away; the unit is released as soon as that's paid.

One thing to be straight with you about: the P2 isn't sitting on the shelf today. It's a pre-order that ships by October 29, 2026, and for a Canadian address it goes out of the warehouse serving Canada, so you were right about that part. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Just reply yes to this email and I'll make the swap and get the invoice out to you.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
